items.heading: Sopa Paraguaya
details: Key ingredients: corn flour, cheese, onion, eggs, milk
Saute onion until soft and sweet.
Mix corn flour with cheese, eggs, milk and the sauteed onion.
Pour the thick batter into a greased baking dish.
Bake until set and golden, like a savory cornbread.

items.heading: Chipa Guasu
details: Key ingredients: fresh corn, cheese, eggs, milk
Blend fresh corn kernels with milk until coarsely pureed.
Mix in eggs, cheese and a little corn flour.
Pour into a baking dish.
Bake until golden and just set in the center.
